# democrito — Full Reference for LLM Agents

Themeable atomic design system with warm industrial aesthetic, three-surface depth,
and three-font semantic typography. Built for data-dense, IDE-inspired applications.

URL:  https://democrito.design
Repo: https://github.com/mmorerasanchez/democrito

## Stack

React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4.2, shadcn/ui, Vite

## Install

Via shadcn registry:
  npx shadcn@latest add https://democrito.design/r/democrito.json democrito

Via git clone:
  git clone https://github.com/mmorerasanchez/democrito.git

## Key files for AI agents

- CLAUDE.md             — coding rules and architecture summary
- DESIGN.md             — visual philosophy and taste layer
- src/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md  — full component inventory and specification
- docs/tokens.md        — full token reference
- docs/theming.md       — theme customization guide
- docs/architecture.md  — atomic design architecture
- /.well-known/mcp.json — AI agent discovery manifest

## Architecture — Atomic Design

| Level      | Directory                    | Count |
|------------|------------------------------|-------|
| Atoms      | src/components/atoms/        | 10    |
| Molecules  | src/components/molecules/    | 18    |
| Organisms  | src/components/organisms/    | 19    |
| Templates  | src/components/templates/    | 7     |

UI primitives in src/components/ui/ are shadcn/ui components — extend via CVA
variants, never modify directly. One component per file, PascalCase filenames,
barrel index.ts per level.

## Themes

- Warm   (`:root`, default) — Sanzo Wada earth-tone palette, warm stone grays + terracotta
- Dark   (`.dark`)
- Light  (`.light`)

Every color token is defined in all three themes in src/index.css.

## Token reference — Dark theme (HSL values)

All colors are HSL CSS custom properties in src/index.css, configured via CSS-first `@theme` in src/index.css.

Surfaces (3-layer hierarchy):
  --background          20 14% 4%
  --surface             20 8%  8%
  --card                12 6%  15%

Text:
  --foreground          60 9%  98%
  --foreground-muted    24 5%  64%
  --foreground-subtle   24 5%  45%

Accent (terracotta):
  --accent              18 65% 55%

Border:
  --border              25 8%  25%

Never hardcode hex/rgb — always use semantic token classes
(bg-surface, text-accent, border-border, etc.).

## Typography — 3-font semantic system

  font-display  Plus Jakarta Sans  — headings
  font-body     Satoshi            — prose / UI text
  font-mono     JetBrains Mono     — data, code, user-generated content

User-editable content (code, data values, prompt variables) must use font-mono.

## Spacing

Base unit: 4px. Scale: 4 · 8 · 12 · 16 · 24 · 32 · 48 · 64.

## Border radius

  --radius  0.75rem   (lg)
  md        calc(var(--radius) - 4px)
  sm        calc(var(--radius) - 8px)

## Layout dimensions

  --header-height      3.5rem
  --sidebar-width      15rem
  --sidebar-collapsed  4rem
  --right-panel        22rem

## Do's

- Check existing atoms/molecules/ui before creating new components
- Use shadcn/ui primitives as base; extend via CVA variants
- Define every new color token in all three themes
- Use semantic tokens (bg-card, text-muted-foreground) not raw colors
- Use font-mono for code, data, and user-editable content

## Don'ts

- Don't write bg-gray-800, text-white, or any hex/rgb literal
- Don't modify shadcn/ui primitives in-place — extend via variants
- Don't add a color token without defining it for all three themes
- Don't skip the TypeScript props interface on a component
